subject: Discovery follow-up: buying controls, payments & hosting preference
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@novacorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: buying controls, payments & hosting preference

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying questions so we can route pricing and procurement correctly:

- Procurement flow: you mentioned Finance prefers POs for platform spend. Can you confirm whether a Purchase Order (Net30) is required for any contract over $25k, or only for multi-month commitments?
- Payment channels: is card payment allowed for initial pilots under $25k, or does procurement require a PO regardless of amount?
- Marketplace: would NovaCorp accept an AWS Marketplace listing (single-click procurement) for pilot purchases, or must all purchases go through your internal PO flow?
- Hosting preference: process/regulatory constraints — do you need a Dedicated or Private deployment for production? For pilot, would Hosted (Redwood API) be acceptable?
- Commit appetite: would you consider a 6–12 month committed throughput (discounted) vs an on-demand rate for the pilot?

If you can reply briefly on the three procurement points (PO requirement, card allowed for pilot, marketplace ok), we’ll tailor the pricing attachment and the proposed commercial path.

I’ve attached a short procurement checklist we use to pre-fill PO terms (saves time).

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: procurement_form_NovaCorp.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)]

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@novacorp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
Cc: NovaCorp Procurement <procure@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: buying controls, payments & hosting preference

Thanks, Sean — good summary.

Answers:
- PO: Finance requires a PO for any contract or spend expected to exceed $25,000 total. For pilots under $25k, card is acceptable if Central Finance pre-approves.
- Card: Yes, card/gateway payment is allowed for pilots <$25k but must be routed through our centralized procurement card. We prefer PO for anything with multi-month commits.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is ideal for smaller purchases (one-off pilots), but onboarding for Marketplace purchases takes ~2 weeks and needs legal sign-off; Finance prefers direct PO for larger quota/commitments.
- Hosting: For pilot, Hosted API is fine. Production-third-party data requires Dedicated or Private (VPC) — that will trigger higher security review.
- Commits: Likely open to a 6-month commitment if we can get an annualized discount; otherwise on-demand for the pilot.

I’m looping in Procurement (procure@novacorp.com) to confirm the PO process and to share any internal forms. I attached our procurement intake form.

Regards,
Liam
Liam Chen
Head of ML Platforms | NovaCorp
[Attachment: NovaCorp_procurement_intake.docx (DOCX, 65 KB)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@novacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Discovery follow-up: buying controls, payments & hosting preference

Thanks Liam — very helpful.

Quick commercial read and recommended next steps (for Sean to send to Procurement):

Pricing / Packaging options we can offer Novacorp:
1) Hosted (API, on-demand)
   - No commit, immediate onboarding, card accepted for pilots
   - Unit pricing: standard on-demand token rate
   - Good for quick pilot; minimal procurement friction
2) Hosted + Commit (6 months)
   - 6-month minimum, monthly invoicing via PO accepted
   - ~15% discount vs on-demand at the committed usage level
   - Includes prefix caching and priority routing
3) Dedicated (reserved GPU pool)
   - Minimum 3-month commit for reserved capacity; invoiced monthly via PO
   - Deeper discount (25%+ depending on commitment) and isolation
   - Better for regulated production
4) Private (VPC/on-prem)
   - Enterprise license + deployment fee; invoicing and support contract
   - Long lead times; appropriate if legal/regulatory requires on-prem

Procurement flow guidance:
- Pilot <$25k: Recommend Hosted (on-demand) and card through procurement card to speed time-to-value.
- Pilot -> Production: Move to Hosted+Commit or Dedicated depending on data/regulatory needs; Draft SOW and invoice via PO.
- Marketplace: Available for pilots but confirm with Procurement due to their ~2-week onboarding.

Attachments: I’m attaching a concise pricing-summary and a pre-filled PO template we can send to procurement to accelerate review.

Ask: Sean — can you (a) confirm target pilot spend (ballpark $)? (b) share procurement contact email we should use for the PO routing? I’ll prepare a short SOW + pricing sheet.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing-summary-novacorp.xlsx (XLSX, 28 KB)]
[Attachment: PO_template_Redwood.docx (DOCX, 12 KB)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>

Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: buying controls, payments & hosting preference

Perfect — thanks Liam and Jordan.

Liam — we’ll propose the Hosted pilot on card for up to $20k to keep it simple. If Procurement confirms PO is required, we’ll convert to a Hosted+Commit 6-month proposal and submit the pre-filled PO (attached). Next steps:

- I’ll send the pricing + SOW draft by EOD today (Jordan to review).
- Procurement: please confirm if we should send the PO to procure@novacorp.com and whether the PO should reference Redwood’s Master Services Agreement (I’ll attach a link).
- If Marketplace is preferred for the pilot, let me know — we can prepare an AWS Marketplace listing but it may add ~2 weeks.
